page.layout: Printed page 314 with running head. Two parallel columns of index entries, left column then right column, each with page references. Below the columns: "FINIS." centred, then a woodcut ornament, then the word "JULI" at the lower right. Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf, and the right-hand edge of the neighbouring page with fragments of text, are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Vox filii est tanquam vox patris, & e contra. 498,9
Usuarius non potest suum jus in alium transferre 201,2
Usucapionem non parit error falsæ causæ. 211.11
in Usu quæ consistunt, id est, quę usu consumuntur vel quasi consumuntur, non recipiunt verum usumfructum. 197,5
in Usu minus juris est quam in usufructu. 201,1
Usufructus a proprietate in perpetuum non separatur. 197,3
Usufructus finitus redit ad suum principium, id est, proprietatem, a qua discesserat. 197,4
Usufructus non partis sed servitutis vicem obtinet 353,12
qui in Utero est, pro jam nat[?] habetur. 278,
Vulgo quæsiti nullum patrem habere intelligunt. 418,
cujus fratris, vel sororis filiam Uxorem ducere non licet, ejusdem nec neptem ducere permittitur. 71,1
eadem duobus simul nupta[?] idem duas Uxores eodem tempore habere non potest. 71,1.
Uxores a viris defendi æquum est, non viros ab uxoribus; 605,

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (cartouche with scrollwork and a mask) below FINIS, not transcribed. Right-hand column is cut off by the scan edge, so the ends of several entries (marked [?]) are partly hidden and their page numbers may be incomplete. The page number "314" is partly unclear in the scan and is read as 314. "JULI" at the lower right is large and may be a catchword or the start of a heading on the facing page; it is recorded as catchword with some doubt. Faint show-through text in the lower middle of the page is not transcribed.
